title: The large-mass limit of interacting quantum gases in the continuum
summary: We study the large-mass limit of interacting quantum (Bose or Fermi) gases in thermal equilibrium. We show that in the suitably-defined large-mass limit, the system gives rise to a gas of classical interacting particles. The corresponding question for bosons on a lattice was previously addressed by Fröhlich, Knowles, Schlein, and the third author. In this work, we study the continuum regime which requires us to suitably tune the chemical potential.
